Starting Tuesday 12 November, you can export any report as a CSV file. Head to Reports → Export to get started.

CSV export is available on all plans. Each export includes all columns currently shown in the report, so you can pull your data into spreadsheets, data warehouses, or any other analysis tool you use.

To export a report:
1. Open the report you want to download.
2. Go to Reports → Export.
3. Choose CSV and save the file.

That's it — your data, ready to go.

- **Weekday phone support hours** are unchanged.

Weekends are when many of us finally have time to dig into projects, update our systems, or just get things done. We wanted to make sure that if something goes wrong during that time, you don't have to wait until the workweek starts to get a human on the line.

We hope this extra Saturday window saves you a little stress and keeps your weekend productive. As always, if you can't make it between 9 am and 1 pm on Saturday, our live chat team is here for you any time of day or night.

Thanks for being with us — happy (and supported) weekends!

We know that sometimes the best time to get help isn't Monday through Friday. That's why we're excited to announce that, starting 30 November, our phone support team will be available on Saturdays.

**What's changing?**

- **Saturday phone support:** Call us from 9:00 am to 1:00 pm on Saturdays for the same friendly, expert help you get on weekdays.
- **Live chat:** Our live chat remains available 24/7, so you can still reach us any time, day or night.
- **Weekday hours:** No changes here—our regular weekday support hours stay exactly the same.

**Why we're doing this**

Many of our customers told us they needed a window to talk to a real person outside of the work week. Saturday mornings give you that chance without waiting until Monday. Whether you're setting up a new account, troubleshooting an issue, or just have a quick question, our support team is ready to help.

**How to reach us**

- **Phone (Saturdays):** 9:00 am – 1:00 pm
- **Live chat:** 24/7, every day
- **Phone (Weekdays):** As always, during our regular business hours

We're committed to making sure you have the support you need, when you need it. Thank you for being part of our community—we can't wait to hear from you this Saturday.

If you have any questions about the new hours or need help before 30 November, drop us a message via live chat anytime.

We know that some of the best moments to tackle your projects—or run into a tricky issue—can land on a Saturday. Starting **30 November**, we're expanding our phone support to Saturdays so you're never stuck waiting until Monday for help.

## What's changing

From 30 November, our phone support line will be open **Saturdays from 9:00 am to 1:00 pm**. Whether you're setting up a new project over the weekend or just need a quick answer before your Monday deadline, our support team will be ready to pick up.

## What stays the same

- **Live chat** remains available around the clock, 24/7, so you can reach us any time of day or night.
- **Weekday phone support hours** are unchanged—our regular Monday-to-Friday schedule continues as usual.

## Why we're doing this

Listening to our customers, we heard that weekend support gaps can be frustrating, especially when a small question turns into a full-day blocker. Adding Saturday phone hours means you get the same friendly, knowledgeable support you expect from us—just with more flexibility.

## How to reach us

- **Phone (Saturdays):** 9:00 am – 1:00 pm, starting 30 November
- **Phone (Weekdays):** As usual
- **Live chat:** 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

We're excited to make support a little more accessible. Happy Saturdays!

— The Support Team

## What's included
Your CSV exports include **all columns currently shown** in the report, so you can take your data into spreadsheets, analysis tools, or wherever else you need it.

## Why we built it
We've heard from many of you that you want a simple, reliable way to get your report data out of the product and into the tools you already use. CSV is a universal, well-supported format that works with everything from Excel and Google Sheets to Python, R, and BI platforms.

## Availability
- **Launch date:** Tuesday, 12 November
- **Plans:** All plans
- **Location:** Reports → Export

If you have questions or feedback, let us know — we're always listening.

Happy exporting!
